svg.title: AI Platform Control Plane: executed AWS pilot architecture
svg.desc: An icon-based architecture diagram of the Terraform-created AWS pilot: public ALB, private EKS, RDS, ECR, Secrets Manager, GitHub OIDC and GitOps, Keycloak, OPA, operator console, and observability.
svg.text: AI Platform Control Plane — executed AWS pilot
Terraform-created, private EKS reference environment with an optional owner-review ALB. Destroyed after validation.
AWS account / us-east-1 — pilot resources had required tags and account-guarded teardown
Private by default. The ALB is optional, HTTP-only owner review; metrics, databases, and cluster administration stay private.
Public subnet contains the optional ALB; application and data services run in private subnets.
Two API, OPA, and worker replicas with PodDisruptionBudgets were exercised.
Boundary: no trusted public TLS or enterprise IdP claim.
